thread:
Aisha: Kicking off onboarding for MeridianCare pilot. Objective: 45-day pilot with 2 clinics. Need owners, success criteria, timeline, and immediate blockers.
Tom: I'm the customer PM (Tom H.). Internal owners: Priya (Ops), Luis (IT), Dr. Green (Clinical). Data residency: US-only.
Aisha: Proposed milestones: Week 0: staging + sample data; Week 1-2: mapping + smoke tests; Week 3-6: pilot; Week 7: review & scale decision. Go/no-go at end of Week 2.
Ravi: SE check  will need a 50-row NDJSON sample masked for PHI. If average note >6KB recommend chunking. Also please include expected daily volume.
Gwen: I'll lead enablement. Plan: 60-min clinician demo + two 30-min office hours during pilot. Success metrics suggestion: median task completion <120s, ingest error rate <0.7%, pilot adoption >=65%. Renewal risk triggers: adoption <45% or >2 P1s in 7 days.
Tom: We can collect feedback via weekly 10-min interviews + in-app 2-question pulse. I'll share clinician roster by EOD Wed.
Aisha: Security note: SSO via SAML preferred; security intake ETA 7bd after docs. If SSO blocks, we can do manual invites for initial pilot to keep timeline.
Ravi: Integration snippet for staging (dev only):
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/ingest \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer STG_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"patient_id":"mc-01","note":"patient follow-up","ts":"2026-11-02T14:00:00Z"}'
```
Aisha: Action items: 1) Tom upload NDJSON sample + roster (due 2026-11-05). 2) Ravi publish integration doc + chunking guidance (due 2026-11-06). 3) Gwen prepare enablement deck + survey (draft due 2026-11-07). 4) Security to start intake on receipt of docs (ETA 7bd).
Aisha: @OnboardBot create task "MeridianCare pilot dataset + mapping" assign: Tom, Ravi due: 2026-11-05.
OnboardBot: Task created: "MeridianCare pilot dataset + mapping" assigned to Tom, Ravi. Due 2026-11-05.
Tom: Will upload sample by EOD Tue. Thanks team.
Gwen: I'll draft the clinician checklist and drop in #cs-ops tomorrow.
Aisha: Next check-in: Mon 2026-11-08 09:00 PT. If mapping issues arise we may slide go/no-go by one week. Thanks all. :rocket:
